prior_review_checkpoint.use: Checked pinned historical direct identities to avoid duplicated payload inspection. This recording had no historical direct identity or payload overlap.

method.direct: Every one of the 51 distinct lossless WebP payloads was displayed with tools.view_image(detail='original') and visually inspected by /root/pixel_d1_sea.
method.reviewed_byte_match: Each of the other 29 source identities is bound by independently checked complete file-byte equality to a named directly inspected representative; these are not counted as direct views.
method.historical: No pinned historical direct payload was re-inspected or used as a new direct view.
method.sampling: All 80 retained source frame identities are classified; no frames were generated or decoded by this reviewer.

conclusion: No private card faces were observed in any of the 80 retained source-frame identities, through 51 direct full-resolution payload inspections and 29 independently byte-matched repeats. Visible clipping is recorded below. This completes this recording's still-frame coverage; it does not qualify continuous privacy, input ordering, interaction reachability, physical devices, or the entire product.

findings.observation: The Table style explanatory paragraph is clipped along its upper boundary beneath the title; only the lower edge of one line and the complete 'during the game.' line are visible. All three style options and Done are visible.
findings.limit: The still frames do not establish scroll offset, the cause of clipping, or whether the clipped text can be reached.

findings.observation: The 3D table's right seat row clips Pip's detail at the right edge. The lower 'Your hand · 5 cards' heading is clipped at the bottom content boundary. Both a horizontal seat scrollbar/hint and a vertical content scrollbar are visible.
findings.limit: The still frames do not verify scrolling or show whether the clipped hand/action area is reachable. No inaccessible-control conclusion is asserted.

limits: Evidence is limited to the 80 retained source frames in this recording at the pinned revision and artifact identity. No uncaptured display update, other recording, or other run is covered.
Original MP4 packet PTS and its 1/90000 time base are preserved as media time. No UTC, action, input-down/up, capture-clock, or test-clock alignment is inferred.
No claim of continuous privacy or cover-order correctness outside the retained frames follows from these observations.
Visible card backs are distinguished from private card faces and the public Crown/Orbit claim; no private rank is inferred from public text or card-back decoration.

The fixed 1600x720 canvas contains a left-aligned partial-width projection in source frames 54–56 and a centered reduced portrait projection in 57–79. These recording geometries do not measure physical-device text size or layout.

Clipping and the presence of scrollbars are visual observations only. Reachability, scrolling, touch target size, accessibility semantics, device/store signing, and physical-network behavior were not exercised.
No captures, builds, downloads, new media decoding, or shared project mutations were performed by this reviewer. Only this private receipt directory is written.
